desc: The NCStar Tactical Dot Sight provides a rich illuminated dot in a remarkable three color options for an incredibly fair price. This dot sight provides three brightness levels for its red, green, and blue reticles to let users quickly adapt and create the best background contrast. This sight additionally sports a cantilever Weaver/Picatinny type mount and ocular/objective flip-up lens covers. The sight is constructed inside of a durable anodized aluminum body which helps protect the lens and electronics from becoming damaged during use. This NCStar Tactical Dot Sight sports multiple similar or improved features at a more affordable price than its competition.
